Themed Escape Rooms

We design escape rooms for any occasion, from birthday celebrations, and seasonal holidays, to diverse cultural events, or purely for kids' enjoyment.

We don't have a physical venue — Ventura brings the entire escape room experience directly to your home or chosen location, fully set up and ready to play.

We tailor challenges to perfectly match each age group, ensuring an engaging experience for everyone involved. Guests will tackle intricate riddles, decode top-secret messages, and assemble hidden clues to successfully break free.

By delivering this captivating mystery directly to your location, we provide a seamless and thrilling escape adventure within the comfort of your own home.
